statements.impact_statement: The exact OUF-owned CGO-disabled SeaweedFS executable excludes all affected golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages from its compilation graph. The containing x/crypto module remains present for other functionality. Evidence is bound to the binary, source, dependency patch, toolchain and graph hashes; rebuilds and advisory scope changes require renewed assessment.
